about: Regions called handwriting (`handwriting_on_page`) that a person looked at in a render of the region, with its page (1-based) and box in points. label: pen (pen strokes) or not_pen (anything else). Not derived from the pen rule. Public files only; `seen` is a short category, never the document's words.
looked_by: the builder of the A18 count (the owner to confirm), 2026-11-20
